deep_analysis.text: Markets lean risk-on into the session, with equities firmer, VIX sharply lower, bitcoin higher, and yields easing, while gold's modest gain and flat DXY leave the safe-haven read inconclusive. This contradicts the broader H4 risk-off backdrop, suggesting sentiment is stabilizing after recent stress even as headline flow highlights building Fed hike bets and dollar strength against European currencies. Commodity-linked and risk-sensitive currencies could see support from the equity and crypto tone, though divergence with softer oil tempers enthusiasm for the dollar bloc. The next major risk is US CPI and PPI data, followed within hours by ECB, BoE, BoC and RBNZ rate decisions, all capable of resetting the dollar's near-term direction.
